description.value:
Requirement You are wielding a loaded chemical or incendiary weapon.

Area 15-foot cone

Duration 1 minute

You do not fire a chem-thrower so much as you decide where the room stops being usable.

Empty the tank across the cone. Each creature in the area takes the weapon’s damage with a basic Reflex save against your class DC. The ground in the cone then remains hazardous for the duration: a creature that enters it or ends its turn there takes persistent damage of the weapon’s type. This is the baseline every other Foul Iron feat is built on.

cinderfall.incomplete: explicitly "the baseline every other Foul Iron feat is built on" per its own text, i.e. this is the unencoded parent that explains why so much of the Foul Iron branch (choke-the-corridor, chain-ignition, it-spreads, downwind, sealed-room, the-air-itself, the-cloud-follows, wildfire, the-long-burn, the-whole-valley, slow-burn, two-tanks, no-clean-ground, nothing-grows-here) has nothing real to extend. This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to. This is a cross-creature effect: it changes a DIFFERENT creature's own roll, HP, condition, healing, or item from the actor's own passive or activated ability, with no companion linked Effect item in this corpus to carry it (unlike the six real *-effect cards this class does have). No selector exists for this anywhere in pf2e-source. This card depends on (upgrades, extends, or is gated behind) another Ironsight card in this same package that itself ships rules: [] -- if the parent has nothing real to build on, the child has nothing real to extend either.
